method.description: Independent comparison of four named nearest-neighbour-normalized source/candidate crop pairs per arm. Whole screenshots and prior labels were not inspected or used.

T20.evidence: Title and toolbar glyph strokes are re-rendered; plants change throughout both canvas crops; the selection border and club head intrude into the right-plant preservation crop; bottom graph, list, and control glyphs are regenerated.

T22.evidence: The bottom UI sits tighter to the boundary and loses the source's complete lower bevel below the tab row; no side padding is introduced.

T20.evidence: Title, menu, and control glyphs differ; both plant crops contain pervasive stem, leaf, and flower redraw; bottom list text, scrollbar, graph curve, and controls are regenerated; a selection-border sliver enters the left-plant preservation crop.

T22.evidence: The bottom crop visibly truncates tab text, the tab row, and lower-left status icons at the canvas boundary, more materially than the exact-size arm.

T20.evidence: All four bounded regions are rescaled and re-rasterized; plant silhouettes, text, icons, graph, and controls do not preserve source pixels or local geometry.

T22.evidence: Broad teal padding appears at both sides while application content is compressed and reframed into a narrower central strip.

T20.evidence: Overall layout is close, but title, menu, and icon strokes, plant foliage and flowers, bottom list text, graph, and control pixels are regenerated across every preservation crop.

T22.evidence: The bottom crop cuts the lower tab bevel and bottoms of tab labels at the canvas edge; no teal side padding is introduced.

cross_arm_note: None passes strict outside-region preservation. Geometry primarily changes T22 severity: exact size is least severe, both 5:4 arms crop the bottom, and 16:9 creates severe pillarboxing and reframing. Human visual approval remains separate.
